_comment: What `devkit export` copies from ${HOME}/.agents into core/.
JSON rather than YAML: the installer parses this with the stdlib only.
layer is the client/toolchain split. 'core' ships in every profile. 'enonic' and 'client'
are overlays a profile opts into. Anything absent from this file is not
exported, and hard_excludes wins over every allowlist entry.
Adding a skill here is a publication decision: run `devkit export --check`
and read the gitleaks report before trusting it.
hard_excludes are anchored at the export root. Prefix with **/ to match a directory of that name at any depth — an unanchored `graft/` would also drop skills/graft/.

benchmarks: the monthly per-source files are hand-adjusted inputs to `agentctl bench`, so each month is listed in the benchmarks section; a new month fails test_every_benchmark_on_disk_is_classified until it is added.

root._comment: Files at the harness root. .agentctl holds every agentctl default (bin/agentctl_defaults.py writes it when absent); a profile links to it.

excluded._comment: Root entries that stay out of the export. Records only: export never reads this map, and hard_excludes or the absence of a root.core entry is what keeps them out.
excluded.docs/dev-process/*.workflow.json: archify sources for the charts; they carry absolute /home output paths
excluded.docs/dev-process/*.visual-check.*: archify visual-check byproducts (screenshots, JSON, extra HTML)
excluded.cron: personal crontab job lines with absolute /home paths; the kit installs no cron job
excluded.tools: one-off apply_patch generators with a hardcoded /home path
excluded.share: tessdata is symlinks into /usr/share and the harness .packages dir; ocr.py falls back to the system tessdata when absent
excluded.ruff.toml: lint config for the harness repo; the kit carries its own ruff.toml
excluded..markdownlint-cli2.jsonc: lint config for the harness repo
excluded..codespellrc: lint config for the harness repo
excluded..githooks: pre-commit gate for the harness repo (generated rules must match sources)
excluded..skill-lock.json: machine state written by the skills CLI (install timestamps, local paths); agentctl_tools.py only reads it from where that CLI put it
excluded..ignore: ripgrep config for the harness repo

excluded._comment: Personal or unshippable. Reason is recorded so the list is auditable.
excluded.enonic-staged-validation-commit-message: legacy name stub; the kit has no use for a redirect
excluded.qa-validation: legacy name stub; the kit has no use for a redirect
excluded.suggest-commit-message: legacy name stub; the kit has no use for a redirect
excluded.validate-qa: legacy name stub; the kit has no use for a redirect
excluded.enonic-marketplace: no SKILL.md; a reference directory, not a skill
excluded.extract-legacy: names a client review host and needs the separately installed extractkit
excluded.graphify: opt-in, heavy, superseded by graft for this kit
excluded.ppt-master: gitignored multi-hundred-MB asset trees; 14 of the 23 broken links

excluded._comment: Vendor projections of skills the skills section keeps out.

rules._comment: AGENTS.md is generated from manifest.json, so the generator and its inputs ship, not a rendered snapshot. `devkit project build` runs generate-agents-md.py --layer <project layers> to render it.

excluded.claude: rendered per profile at sync from manifest.json; a snapshot here would go stale
excluded.AGENTS.md: generated at install from manifest.json plus agents.d; do not export a snapshot

excluded.implementation/How-to-import-legacy-clau: machine-specific one-off; superseded by `devkit profile session-sync`
excluded.calibration/classify-ticket-autonomy/Cal: specific Jira keys; host-local run log
excluded.calibration/classify-ticket-autonomy/Cor: specific Jira keys; host-local precedent map
excluded.implementation/How-to-sync-claude-deskto: documents bin/sync-claude-desktop-personal.py, which is excluded; kit appfork replaces it

excluded.fix-claude-desktop-personal-perms.sh: companion to the Personal desktop fork; kit appfork owns profile dest trees
excluded.scheduled-push-branches.py: one-shot client cron; hardcodes acme-group keys
excluded.sync-claude-desktop-personal.py: Personal desktop fork worker; kit appfork rebuilds per-profile GUI forks

bin_vendor._comment: Per-vendor scripts that sync-bin-projections.sh links into each vendor scripts dir.

excluded.claude_personal: Claude Personal is no longer a harness (e52fda9)

excluded.graft-guard.py: maintainer guard: git-restores tracked files in the harness git checkout, and the kit does not wire graft hooks

benchmarks._comment: Inputs to `agentctl bench place` plus the snapshot ROLES.md was derived from. Monthly per-source files are hand-adjusted, so they ship.

excluded.graft: removed from catalog 2026-09-27; directory is .cache, do not re-admit

excluded.client-overlay.json: the real client overlay; the client profile ships its own
excluded.export-scrub.json: private scrub rules; they name what the kit must not track, so they stay out of it

docs._comment: The user guide and the process charts it links to. Listed by file: the dev-process folder also holds visual-check screenshots (about 3 MB) and *.workflow.json diagram sources that carry the maintainer's absolute output path, which stay out.
